\section[a possibilidade]{a possibilidade — a possibility}

\label{lesson:PT-C161-possibilidade}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for a foreigner; abroad, then the Portuguese for a tourist.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: a possibilidade}
\textbf{a possibilidade} — \textquotedblleft{}a possibility\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{possibilidade} $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{possibilitas}, \textquotedblleft{}possibility\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB 2.1), from \emph{possibilis}, \textquotedblleft{}possible\textquotedblright{} — a learned borrowing from Latin.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Portuguese for a foreigner; abroad, then the Portuguese for a tourist, then say \emph{a possibilidade} again
\end{itemize}

\section[o resultado]{o resultado — a result}

\label{lesson:PT-C161-resultado}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for a tourist, then the Portuguese for a possibility.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: o resultado}
\textbf{o resultado} — \textquotedblleft{}a result\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{resultado} is built from the verb \textquotedblleft{}to result\textquotedblright{}, which $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{resultare}, \textquotedblleft{}to spring back\textquotedblright{} (Lewis \& Short).
\end{cousinweb}
